Get Channel Posts with Extended Webhook and Thread Metadata

mm_get_channel_posts.Rd

Convenience wrapper around get_channel_posts that defaults include_metadata = TRUE (extracting root_id, override_username, and from_webhook) and preserves Mattermost's reverse-chronological post ordering.

Usage

mm_get_channel_posts(
  channel_id,
  page = 0,
  per_page = 60,
  since = NULL,
  include_metadata = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  auth = get_default_auth()
)

Arguments

channel_id

The Mattermost channel ID.

page

(Integer) The page to select (0-based). Default is 0.

per_page

(Integer) The number of posts per page. Default is 60, maximum is 200.

since

(Optional) A POSIXct, Date, or numeric (Unix time in milliseconds) value. When provided, returns all posts created or modified after this time, up to a server-side limit of 1000 posts. **Cannot** be combined with `page` or `per_page`.

include_metadata

Boolean. If `TRUE`, appends `root_id`, `override_username`, and `from_webhook` columns extracted from post metadata. Default is `FALSE`.

verbose

Boolean. If `TRUE`, the function will print request/response details for more information.

auth

The authentication object created by `authenticate_mattermost()`.

Value

A data frame of posts ordered newest-first, including extended metadata columns (root_id, override_username, from_webhook) when include_metadata = TRUE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  posts <- mm_get_channel_posts("channel_id_here", per_page = 60)
} # }
